claim: Capacity is per SKU and not interchangeable: the 8 GB card (10de:20c2) unlocks to 64 GB and the 10 GB card (10de:2082) unlocks to 40 GB, and an 80 GB configuration for 10 GB cards was built, tested and rejected as unstable.
stance_target: the repo's 64 GB-per-card premise, while bounding it to the 8 GB SKU — a 10 GB SKU pool would deliver only 200 GB across five cards, not 320 GB
scope_conditions: CMP 170HX 8 GB SKU 10de:20c2 and 10 GB SKU 10de:2082; wiki current as of 2026-07-31
quoted_support: **Capacity is per SKU and is not interchangeable.** The 8 GB card (`10de:20c2`) unlocks to **64 GB**. The 10 GB card (`10de:2082`) unlocks to **40 GB**. The 80 GB configuration for 10 GB cards was built, tested, and rejected as unstable.

claim: PCIe link speed and link width are separate problems: Gen1 to Gen2 is a software unlock shipped in cmpunlocker master since 2026-07-29 so any unlocked card runs Gen2, but going beyond x4 width requires hand-soldering 24 AC coupling capacitors, and neither unlock achieves the other.
stance_target: the repo's 'PCIe Gen2 x4' premise — it is the correct default unlocked state, and the width ceiling is a hardware population issue rather than a firmware one
scope_conditions: All CMP 170HX cards; cmpunlocker master since 2026-07-29; capacitor mod on 12 of 16 lanes
quoted_support: **PCIe link speed and link width are separate problems.** Gen1 to Gen2 is a software unlock, shipped in cmpunlocker `master` since 2026-07-29, so any card with the unlock installed runs Gen2. Going beyond x4 width requires hand soldering 24 AC coupling capacitors. Neither one achieves the other.
